title: Gluten-Free Blueberry Dutch Baby
changes_from_base: Gluten-free: sweet rice flour replaces wheat flour in a blender batter with lemon zest and vanilla; blueberries are scattered over before baking so they burst in the puff.
summary: A gluten-free pancake that puffs dramatically in the oven, studded with juicy blueberries and dusted with icing sugar.
equipment: 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat Pan
steps.text: Preheat a 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan on the lower-middle shelf as the oven preheats to 220 °C (200 °C fan).

steps.title: Blend Batter
steps.text: Blend 4 large eggs, 240 ml whole milk, 80 g sweet rice flour, 25 g caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp finely grated lemon zest and ½ tsp fine salt for about 30 seconds until very smooth.

steps.title: Butter Pan
steps.text: Using oven gloves, move the hot pan to a wire rack, add 42 g unsalted butter in 3 pieces and swirl until melted and the base is coated; quickly pour in the batter and scatter 140 g blueberries over.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Return to the oven and bake 17-20 minutes until puffed, deep golden and the berries burst.

steps.title: Dust
steps.text: Dust lightly with 1 tbsp icing sugar and serve straight away, as it sinks quickly once cooled.

tips: Scatter the blueberries over just before the pan goes into the oven so they burst into the puff instead of sinking.
Blend the batter thoroughly until completely smooth for even, impressive rising
Have all equipment ready before blending as the batter must go into the hot pan immediately
safety: Keep oven gloves on the hot pan handle throughout cooking for safety
storage: Serve immediately whilst puffed. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
